en: I have a metallic taste in my mouth.

zh: 早上醒来时，我的手腕很僵硬。
en: My wrists feel very stiff when I wake up in the morning.
focus: Unseen symptom and body part: wrist stiffness

zh: 我没有胸痛，也没有呼吸困难。
en: I do not have chest pain or difficulty breathing.
focus: Preserve both negations; do not add symptoms

en: I feel short of breath when I walk upstairs.
The fingers on my right hand feel a little numb.
focus: Preserve right side, fingers, and mild numbness

zh: 我昨天晚上测到体温是三十八点二度。
en: My temperature was 38.2 degrees Celsius last night.

zh: 我只吃了半片药，不是一整片。
en: I only took half a tablet, not a whole tablet.

zh: 我两周前开始服用一种新药。
en: I started taking a new medicine two weeks ago.
focus: Preserve new medicine and two weeks

zh: 我躺下后胃酸会反上来。
en: I get acid reflux when I lie down.
focus: Unseen symptom: reflux when lying down

zh: 我尿尿的时候有灼烧感。
en: I have a burning sensation when I urinate.

zh: 我没有摔倒，但肩膀一直不舒服。
en: I have not fallen, but my shoulder has been uncomfortable.
focus: Preserve negation and ongoing shoulder discomfort
